story.title: A quiet counter for better coffee.
story.p1: {name} is a specialty café built for unhurried mornings — single-origin lots, careful milk texture, and a room that feels like a pause in the day.
story.p2: This codebase is production-shaped: typed content, composables, Tailwind design tokens, and APIs you can connect to email or CRM.

gallery.title: The room, the light, the cup.
gallery.note: Photography placeholders — replace with your own café shots in production.

visitBlock.title: Find {name}
visitBlock.lede: Walk in, take a seat by the window, and stay as long as the cup lasts.

order.title: Order ahead
order.lede: Build a pickup order, then we’ll confirm by email. Payment stays at the counter for this demo flow.

newsletter.title: Seasonal notes in your inbox.
newsletter.lede: New lots, events, and quiet updates — a few times a month, never noisy.
